invariant_variable_names.agency_id: Must use 'agency_id' in all SQL queries (SEC-02)
invariant_variable_names.advisory_lock: Must use 'SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext($1), hashtext($2))' with [String(agency_id), String(code).toUpperCase()]
invariant_variable_names.session_table: Must use 'public.broker_sessions' with composite key (broker_id, session_type); types: draft, edit, search_state, session_context, pending_search, cooldown_*
invariant_variable_names.telemetry_table: Must use 'public.operation_logs' for structured operational telemetry
invariant_variable_names.outbound_messages: Handlers must send through lib/dispatcher.js reply* / react only; a turn is answered only when WhatsApp accepts the message
